Name: Project Moonlight Map Resources
Author: Glitchfinder
Description:
[size=4][font=Tahoma][b]Project Moonlight Map Resources [/b][/font][/size][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]is a pack of unfinished maps (both new and modified) from an unfinished large scale collaboration. Project Moonlight was part of a much larger project I was working on with bwdy, that is currently stalled. I have received permission to release my unfinished maps as resources for other mod creators to use in their own projects.[/size][/font][/font][size=3]

[center][size=5][b]What does this pack contain?[/b][/size][/center][/size][list]
[*]Four unfinished maps designed to fill gaps in the original Stardew Valley world map.
[*]Nine Stardew Valley maps modified to better fit each other and the new maps.
[/list][center]


[size=5][b]What does this mean if I want to use it?[/b][/size][/center][list]
[*]Any maps you want to use will need to be properly connected to existing maps and any other custom maps you add.
[*]This was developed and stalled during 1.3, which means it does not include any changes or updates from 1.4
[*]Some changes, such as the modified backwoods and bus stop maps, are going to require specific work to make functional and generally compatible with other mods.
[*]Crediting me (Glitchfinder) and bwdy would be appreciated, but not required.
[/list]
